title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Desk Guidance: Rack Rate on the Alignment Check Fee for Vehicles from a Customer-Pay Repair
content:
The rack rate on the alignment check fee of an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order is **0.75** where the order's source is a network customer-pay repair that is still open (opened, in repair or awaiting approval), **0.90** where its source is a network customer-pay repair that is ready, delivered or closed, and **1** otherwise.

The rate multiplies the tier's alignment check fee for one check.

## Records the rate is read from

The rate is read from the calibration order's recorded source and, where that source is a network customer-pay repair, from the status of that Customer-Pay Repairs order.

| Order's source | Status of the source customer-pay repair | Rack rate |
|---|---|---|
| Network customer-pay repair | opened | 0.75 |
| Network customer-pay repair | in repair | 0.75 |
| Network customer-pay repair | awaiting approval | 0.75 |
| Network customer-pay repair | ready | 0.90 |
| Network customer-pay repair | delivered | 0.90 |
| Network customer-pay repair | closed | 0.90 |
| Glass replacement, collision repair, warranty rework or customer request | — | 1 |

## Illustration (hypothetical fee for one check of 59.95 USD)

With the source customer-pay repair still in repair, the fee for one check becomes 59.95 multiplied by 0.75, that is 44.9625 USD. With the source repair delivered, it becomes 53.955 USD. On an order opened on the customer's own request, the rate is 1 and the fee for one check stays 59.95 USD.
